title: sdks: unify auth/retries and stabilize streaming ergonomics across py/ts/go (v1.33.0)
author: Maya Verma
description: This PR unifies authentication and retry behaviors across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, stabilizes streaming APIs for parity and ergonomics, and bumps SDK versions to v1.33.0. Motivation: customers have reported inconsistent retry semantics and auth header handling across language SDKs; streaming ergonomics diverged between TS and Python which caused integration friction. Changes include a shared auth middleware contract, a common retry policy implementation backed by circuit-breaker-friendly backoff, consistent streaming client APIs with unified event types and helper wrappers, and small ergonomic improvements (typed responses in TS, context.Context support in Go, and synchronous iterator helper in Python). The description below summarizes scope, tests, and migration notes. Scope: - sdks/python: new redwood.auth.AuthClient, unified RetryPolicy, streaming iterator helper (stream_lines) and improved docs/examples. - sdks/typescript: consolidated auth middleware, retry policy alignment with python/go, updated streaming types and example usage, added auto-reconnect helper for flaky networks. - sdks/go: added context-aware streaming client, unified auth credentials interface, and retry wrapper compatible with go's error semantics. Migration notes: existing users will need to update imports for AuthClient and the retry options shape; both old and new constructors are temporarily supported via shim for one release with deprecation warnings. Tests: unit tests added for each SDK, interop tests validate round-trip streaming with the redwood test harness, and e2e smoke tests for auth+retries. Release: version bumps and changelogs updated for v1.33.0.
commits: feat(sdk): introduce common auth middleware and AuthClient shim
feat(sdk): add unified RetryPolicy with exponential_backoff jitter
refactor(py): streaming iterator helper and docs
refactor(ts): streaming types and auto-reconnect helper
feat(go): context-aware streaming client and retry wrapper
test: add interop streaming tests and e2e smoke tests
chore: version bumps and changelogs for v1.33.0
review_comments: Ethan: Left a note about edge case when token refresh fails mid-stream; please ensure stream error surfaces the original cause. Author: added propagation of underlying AuthError and unit test to cover mid-stream refresh failure.
Priya: Can we make retry backoff configurable via client options rather than environment? Author: added RetryOptions to constructor with defaults and documented it in examples.

Liam: Go API should accept context.Context for cancellation; also nit to use time.Ticker instead of sleep in reconnection loop. Author: updated streaming client to accept context and replaced sleep with ticker + backoff; added tests.
release_notes: SDKs: Unify auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go. Stabilize streaming APIs and improve ergonomics. Breaking changes: none immediate; deprecation shims provided for transitional imports. Upgrade to v1.33.0.
